package this.package.location

import this.import1
import this.import2

public class ClassName implements DifferentClass {
    public static final int STATIC_FIELD; // Fields at top of class.
    public int publicField; // Ordered final ->

    public ClassName(int publicField) { // Constructors right beneath fields
        this.publicField = publicField;
    }

    public int getPublicField() { // Accessors and then mutators beneath the constructor
        return publicField; // Omit "this" keyword when possible
    }

    public void setPublicField(int publicField) { // "get" or "set" before the name of the value being accessed or mutated
        this.publicField = publicField;
    }

    /**
    * Explanation of method if necessary
    * @param parameter
    * @see ClassThatIsRelevantOrUsedAsATemplate
    * @author Author of comment if necessary
    */
    public returnType publicMethod() {  // Public types go above private types
        int integerValue = 1; // Most primiative data type at the top
        int secondInt;
        float floatingPoint = 0.1F; // Capital letters for explicitly casting floating point values
        double floatDouble = 0.2; // No cast necessary for doubles
    }

    private class innerClass {
        public static final float VALUE_OF_PI = 3.14F; // Final fields can have uppercase camel-case names
    }

    static {
            // Static block space if needed
    }

    @Override // Annotate overridden methods. Overridden methods go beneath other code
    private returnType privateMethod(int paramForThing, BlockPos pos, Optional<Value> value) { // Parameter names should be descriptive and not single characters (unless the parameter clearly represents a vector component (e.g. x, y, z))
        int number = 0;

        if (number > 1) { // Single spacing separating variables from method calls, if statement blocks, etc.
            int secondNumber = 1;

            setpublicField(secondNumber);
        }
    }
}
